_about: Fog over the airfields (Brian, 22 November 2026: fog or storms ground a base's bombers that month, raids come in waves when the skies clear). src/campaign/fog.ts; the design director's rulings of 22 November 17:44Z: fog closes the field, so every aircraft at a fogged base is grounded, fighters too (R4); the table is laid only from the historian's figures (R5); the waves are words only (R6). 'on' is the switch for a new grand campaign; 'sourced' must be true too before it can ship on, and is false while 'odds' holds the air thread's PLACEHOLDERS (never to ship). 'odds': for each weather zone (weather.json keys), the chance in tenths, January to December, that fog or a storm closes one airfield for the month.

words.card: Fog has closed its airfield this month: nothing there can take off.
words.why: Fog has closed the airfield at {base} this month: nothing there can take off.
words.month: Fog closed {n} of your airfields this month ({where}): {groups} stayed on the ground.
words.wave: The fog has lifted: {groups} that sat it out are fit to fly again.
